    Profile

    Zehn is a man who is known as the Veda Templar's "Number Ten." He continues to fight out of the half-belief, half-hope that he will be able to get back his wife and daughter if he discovers "the truth." This almost delusion-like conviction is what won him the help of the "legendary blacksmith" who was said to take orders from no one.

    Origin: Lost Blue
    Gender: Male
    Height: 183cm
    Weight: 78kg
    Birthday: Sep 3
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: His wife and daughter
    Hobbies: Meditation
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 竹内良太
